import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        long best_num = -1;
        long best_den = 1; // Initialize to avoid division by zero

        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long j = (i * x) / y;
            if (i * x - j * y > (j + 1) * y - i * x) {
                j++;
            }
            if (best_num == -1 || Math.abs(j * y - i * x) * best_den < Math.abs(best_num * y - best_den * x) * i) {
                best_num = j;
                best_den = i;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(best_num + "/" + best_den);
        sc.close();
    }
}
